words.definition: adj. 腐烂的；糟糕的；恶劣的，不正派的

examples.en: The smell of rotten eggs filled the entire laboratory.
examples.zh: 臭鸡蛋的气味充满了整个实验室。

examples.en: The report concluded that the whole system was rotten to the core.
examples.zh: 报告的结论是：整个体制已腐朽透顶。

words.usage: 本义腐烂发臭：rotten eggs 臭蛋；引申「糟糕的」（英式口语）：a rotten day 倒霉的一天。习语 rotten to the core 坏到骨子里；spoil sb rotten 把人宠上天。谚语 One rotten apple spoils the barrel 一颗烂苹果坏一整桶。
collocations: rotten eggs 臭蛋
rotten to the core 腐朽透顶
spoil sb rotten 把某人宠坏
words.mnemonic: rot（烂）+t+en，同 got→gotten 双写 → 腐烂的

words.definition: vt. 唤醒，弄醒；激起，唤起（情感或行动）

examples.en: The alarm roused him from a deep sleep at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，闹钟把他从沉睡中唤醒。

examples.en: The leader's passionate speech roused the crowd to action.
examples.zh: 领袖慷慨激昂的演讲激励人群行动起来。

words.usage: rouse sb from sleep 把某人从睡梦中唤醒；rouse sb to action 激励行动；rouse suspicion or anger 引起怀疑、激起愤怒。近形词 arouse 更抽象，多接情绪类宾语：arouse interest or concern，二者区分是完形与选词填空常考点。
collocations: rouse sb from sleep 唤醒某人
rouse sb to action 激励行动
rouse public anger 激起公愤
words.mnemonic: rouse 唤醒人，arouse 唤起情绪，一实一抽象

words.definition: n. 庄稼，作物；收成；一批，一群

examples.en: Farmers in the delta harvest two crops of rice a year.
examples.zh: 三角洲的农民一年收获两季水稻。

examples.en: The drought cut this year's wheat crop by nearly a third.
examples.zh: 干旱使今年的小麦收成减少了近三分之一。

words.usage: 农业核心词：grow crops 种庄稼、crop yields 粮食产量、a bumper crop 大丰收，农业环保话题高频。a crop of 一批、一连串：a crop of scandals 一连串丑闻。动词短语 crop up（问题、机会）突然出现、冒头，口语与阅读都常见。
collocations: crop yields 粮食产量
a bumper crop 大丰收
crop up 突然出现
words.mnemonic: crop up 冒头，像庄稼破土 → 庄稼、收成

words.definition: n. 环岛；（英旧）旋转木马；adj. 绕圈子的，拐弯抹角的

examples.en: Turn left at the second roundabout and follow the road signs.
examples.zh: 在第二个环岛左转，然后按路标行驶。

examples.en: She hinted, in a roundabout way, that the project might be cancelled.
examples.zh: 她拐弯抹角地暗示，这个项目可能会被取消。

words.usage: 英式交通词「环岛」，美式多说 traffic circle 或 rotary。形容词义拐弯抹角：in a roundabout way 间接地、绕着弯子：I heard it in a roundabout way 我是间接听来的。英式旧义还指旋转木马，文学作品里能见到。
collocations: in a roundabout way 拐弯抹角地
turn at the roundabout 在环岛转弯
traffic roundabout 交通环岛
words.mnemonic: round（绕圈）+about（周围）→ 绕着圈走 → 环岛、绕圈子

words.definition: adj. 精美的，精致的；剧烈的（痛）；敏锐的

examples.en: The palace houses a collection of exquisite jade carvings.
examples.zh: 这座宫殿收藏着一批精美的玉雕。

examples.en: The designer has an exquisite sense of color and proportion.
examples.zh: 这位设计师对色彩与比例有着敏锐的鉴赏力。

words.usage: 指工艺、感受细腻至极：exquisite craftsmanship 精湛工艺、exquisite taste 高雅品位；文学中修饰剧痛：exquisite pain 痛彻心扉。词根 quis「寻求」与 question 同源，本义「精挑细选出的」。派生：exquisitely adv. 精美地，精致地。
collocations: exquisite craftsmanship 精湛工艺
exquisite taste 高雅品位
exquisite detail 精美细节
words.mnemonic: ex+quis（求，question 同根）+ite → 千挑万选 → 精美

words.definition: adj. 潮湿的，湿热的

examples.en: Summers in the south are hot and unbearably humid.
examples.zh: 南方的夏天湿热难耐。

examples.en: The humid climate suits the growth of tropical orchids.
examples.zh: 湿润的气候适宜热带兰花的生长。

words.usage: 指空气潮湿含水的：humid climate 湿润气候、humid air 潮湿空气，盛夏常 hot and humid 又闷又湿。派生：humidity n. 湿度，气象学 relative humidity 相对湿度；humidifier n. 加湿器。辨析：damp 微潮带贬义，moist 指恰到好处的湿润。
collocations: humid climate 湿润气候
humid air 潮湿空气
relative humidity 相对湿度
words.mnemonic: hum（昏沉）+id：闷热潮湿让人昏昏欲睡

words.definition: n. 先知，预言家；倡导者，鼓吹者

examples.en: The Old Testament prophets often criticized the kings of Israel.
examples.zh: 《旧约》中的先知们常常批评以色列的君王。

examples.en: As a prophet of doom, he predicted the crash a year earlier.
examples.zh: 作为悲观预言者，他早一年就预言了这场崩盘。

words.usage: 宗教义为先知，大写 the Prophet 特指穆罕默德；引申预言者、倡导者：a prophet of doom 唱衰者、悲观预言者。易混对：动词拼作 prophesy，名词拼作 prophecy，一音之差是拼写考点。派生：prophetic adj. 预言的、有预见性的。
collocations: a prophet of doom 悲观预言者
Old Testament prophets 旧约先知
prophet of the digital age 数字时代先知
words.mnemonic: prophet 与 profit 同音：先知也谈利润，一音两词

words.definition: vt. 彻底检修，大修；全面改革；n. 大修；彻底变革

examples.en: The aging bridge must be overhauled before the rainy season arrives.
examples.zh: 这座老桥必须在雨季来临前彻底检修。

examples.en: The new government promised a complete overhaul of the tax system.
examples.zh: 新政府承诺对税收制度进行全面改革。

words.usage: 机械义彻底检修：overhaul the engine 大修发动机；引申全面革新：a radical overhaul of the tax system 税制全面改革，社会制度类阅读高频。赛车语境指反超对手：overhaul the leader。派生：overhauling n. 大修，检修作业。
collocations: a radical overhaul 彻底改革
overhaul the engine 大修发动机
overhaul the tax system 全面革新税制
words.mnemonic: over（全）+haul（拉）→ 整机拉散了修 → 大修、革新

words.definition: n. 伪善；虚伪行为

examples.en: They condemned the hypocrisy of preaching virtue while taking bribes.
examples.zh: 他们谴责一边宣扬道德一边收受贿赂的虚伪行径。

examples.en: His hypocrisy was exposed when his private dealings came to light.
examples.zh: 私下交易曝光后，他的伪善面目暴露无遗。

words.usage: 不可数名词，常与 expose、condemn 搭配。派生：hypocrite n. 伪君子；hypocritical adj. 虚伪的。写作可替换 insincerity 增色。
collocations: expose one's hypocrisy 揭露某人的虚伪
moral hypocrisy 道德伪善
sheer hypocrisy 纯粹的虚伪
words.mnemonic: hypo（下）+crisy（判断）→ 表面一套暗地一套 → 伪善

words.definition: adj. 易于…的；俯卧的

examples.en: The coastal region is prone to flooding during the rainy season.
examples.zh: 该沿海地区雨季容易发生洪涝。

examples.en: Tired drivers are more prone to make errors of judgment.
examples.zh: 疲劳的司机更容易出现判断失误。

words.usage: 表语形容词，prone to sth／to doing sth 表易于发生，多指坏事。不接不定式，与 likely 用法不同。派生：error-prone 常见。
collocations: be prone to accidents 容易出事故
prone to anger 动辄发怒
error-prone 易出错的
words.mnemonic: prone→谐音「扑」：扑倒在地 → 俯卧；易扑坑 → 易于

words.definition: vt./vi. 爆裂；突然发作；n. 爆发，一阵

examples.en: The pipe burst in the night and flooded the kitchen.
examples.zh: 水管半夜爆裂，厨房被淹了。

examples.en: The audience burst into applause when she finished the speech.
examples.zh: 她演讲结束时，观众爆发出阵阵掌声。

words.usage: 过去式、过去分词均为 burst。burst into tears／laughter、burst out crying 为核心句型；名词 a burst of applause 一阵掌声。
collocations: burst into tears 突然大哭
a burst of applause 一阵掌声
burst out laughing 突然大笑
words.mnemonic: 拟声「砰」：东西炸开 → 爆裂、突发

words.definition: n. 王冠，王位；冠军称号；vt. 为…加冕

examples.en: The crown passed peacefully to the young prince.
examples.zh: 王位和平地传给了年轻的王子。

examples.en: Their years of patient research were finally crowned with success.
examples.zh: 他们多年耐心研究终于获得成功。

words.usage: 本义王冠，引申指冠军头衔、最高荣誉。vt. crown sb king 为…加冕；be crowned with success 以成功告终，写作加分。派生：crowned adj. 戴王冠的。

synonyms.note: 泛指荣誉；crown 指最高荣誉

collocations: crown prince 王储
win the crown 夺得冠军
be crowned with success 圆满成功
words.mnemonic: crow（乌鸦）+n → 乌鸦落头顶如戴王冠

words.definition: vt. 推翻，打倒；n. 推翻

examples.en: The revolutionaries sought to overthrow the old regime by force.
examples.zh: 革命者试图以武力推翻旧政权。

examples.en: The overthrow of the dictator was welcomed around the world.
examples.zh: 独裁者被推翻，举世为之欢呼。

words.usage: 过去式 overthrew，过去分词 overthrown。宾语多为 government、regime 等制度对象。the overthrow of… 指「…的推翻」。
collocations: overthrow the government 推翻政府
overthrow a regime 颠覆政权
the overthrow of the old order 旧秩序的推翻
words.mnemonic: over（翻）+throw（扔）→ 掀翻扔倒 → 推翻

words.definition: n. 加班，加班费；加时赛

examples.en: She puts in a lot of overtime to support her family.
examples.zh: 她加班加点以养活家人。

examples.en: The basketball game was decided in overtime.
examples.zh: 这场篮球比赛在加时赛中分出胜负。

words.usage: 不可数名词。work overtime 加班；overtime pay 加班费；be on overtime 正在加班。体育语境 go into overtime 指进入加时赛。

synonyms.note: 口语指额外时间或报酬

collocations: work overtime 加班
overtime pay 加班费
go into overtime 进入加时赛
words.mnemonic: over（超出）+time（时间）→ 超时工作 → 加班

words.definition: vt. 猛投，力掷；大声叫骂

examples.en: Rioters hurled bottles and stones at the police line.
examples.zh: 骚乱者向警阵投掷瓶子和石块。

examples.en: He hurled abuse at the referee after the controversial call.
examples.zh: 那次有争议的判罚后，他对裁判破口大骂。

words.usage: 力度强于 throw，强调愤怒地掷。hurl sth at sb 朝某人猛掷；hurl abuse at sb 大骂某人。骚乱报道高频，写作可替换 throw。
collocations: hurl abuse at sb 辱骂某人
hurl stones at the police 向警察投掷石块
hurl insults 大声辱骂
words.mnemonic: 谐音「嗬—」吼着把东西甩出去 → 猛掷

words.definition: n. 发明，发明物；虚构

examples.en: The invention of the steam engine transformed manufacturing.
examples.zh: 蒸汽机的发明改变了制造业。

examples.en: Critics dismissed the report as a clever invention.
examples.zh: 批评者斥该报告为巧妙的编造。

words.usage: 指发明行为不可数，指发明物可数：the invention of sth。引申义「虚构」常见于阅读。派生：invent vt. 发明；inventor n. 发明家。

synonyms.note: 创新，强调新方法新思想

collocations: the invention of the telephone 电话的发明
a great invention 伟大的发明
a complete invention 纯属虚构
words.mnemonic: in（进入）+vent（来）→ 想出来带到世上 → 发明

words.definition: n. 宣传，鼓吹（常含贬义）

examples.en: The regime used propaganda to shape public opinion.
examples.zh: 该政权利用宣传来左右舆论。

examples.en: The leaflets were nothing but war propaganda.
examples.zh: 这些传单不过是战争宣传品而已。

words.usage: 不可数名词，含贬义，指政治鼓吹；中性「宣传」用 publicity。搭配 political propaganda、a propaganda campaign。媒体阅读高频。
collocations: political propaganda 政治宣传
a propaganda campaign 宣传运动
anti-war propaganda 反战宣传
words.mnemonic: propagate 亲戚：批量灌输 → 宣传（贬）

words.definition: adj. 脆的；清爽的；干脆利落的

examples.en: We set out for a walk in the crisp autumn air.
examples.zh: 我们在清爽的秋日空气中出门散步。

examples.en: The chairman gave a crisp summary of the main points.
examples.zh: 主席对要点作了简明扼要的总结。

words.usage: 本义酥脆，引申指空气清爽、回答干脆、文风简洁。比较级 crisper。名词可指薯片（英式）。写作可用 a crisp style。
collocations: crisp air 清爽的空气
a crisp answer 干脆利落的回答
crisp potato chips 酥脆薯片
words.mnemonic: 拟声「咔嚓」：咬薯片 → 脆的 → 干脆

words.definition: vt. 使伤残；严重削弱，使瘫痪

examples.en: The prolonged strike crippled the nation's railway network.
examples.zh: 长期罢工使该国铁路网陷入瘫痪。

examples.en: The country was crippled by mounting foreign debts.
examples.zh: 该国被不断累积的外债拖垮了。

words.usage: vt. 引申义「使瘫痪、严重削弱」为考点：be crippled by debts。名词指跛子已含冒犯义，慎用。派生：crippling adj. 极有害的。
collocations: cripple the economy 重创经济
be crippled by debts 被债务压垮
a crippling blow 沉重打击
words.mnemonic: creep（爬）+ple → 只能爬 → 使瘫痪

words.definition: n. 惊吓；恐怖

examples.en: The sudden knock at the door gave her a fright.
examples.zh: 突然的敲门声吓了她一跳。

examples.en: The horse took fright at the sound of thunder and ran off.
examples.zh: 马被雷声惊到，跑了出去。

words.usage: 固定搭配为主：take fright at sth 受惊；give sb a fright 吓一跳；in fright 惊恐地。派生：frighten vt. 使惊吓；frightful adj. 可怕的。
collocations: give sb a fright 吓某人一跳
take fright at sth 受惊
in fright 惊恐地
words.mnemonic: frighten 的名词 → 突如其来的惊吓
